capabilities: Map a local folder to a local HTTP server that serves its images as http:// URLs
Copy generated URLs or Markdown snippets for wallpaper images
Preview images from the folder with pagination in the settings page
Configure server port, hostname and image folder path, including paths outside the vault
Recover automatically from port conflicts by incrementing the port
disambiguation: Not a remote image host or file sync service; it runs a loopback-only local server that serves your own folder as fake online URLs.
extras: Desktop-only (Node.js built-in http module). Bilingual Chinese/English README includes a disclosure section stating the server listens only on loopback (default localhost:8989) and that configuring an absolute path lets it read files outside the vault. Installable via Community Marketplace, BRAT, or manual download.
intentEvidence: solves the limitation of Obsidian's wallpaper feature (online URLs only)
motivation: The author built it to fix the pain point that Obsidian's wallpaper feature only supports online URLs and cannot use local images.
problem: Obsidian's wallpaper/background setting only accepts online URLs, so local images cannot be used as wallpapers without hosting them somewhere.
summary: Local HTTP server plugin that maps a folder of local images to http:// URLs usable in Obsidian's wallpaper settings.
